author: Praxis V
title: FWPCA-only baseline: kd=22, δ=0.12, k=50 (seed=0) — explicit corrected run
abstract: Corrected generalization test: explicitly calls lineage utility run_fwpca_only with δ=0.12, kd=22, k=50, seed=0 to avoid wrapper parameter leaks.

original_submission.content:
import sys, anndata as ad
sys.path.append('storage/praxis')
from fwpca_only_utils import run_fwpca_only

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    print("[fwpca-only] kd=22, d=0.12, k=50, a_g=0.5, seed=0 (no PBVE) — explicit")
    return run_fwpca_only(
        adata,
        alpha_g=0.50,
        kdensity=22,
        k_total=50,
        delta=0.12,
        metric='cosine',
        cap=2.0,
        rng_seed=0,
        pbve_temper=None
    )
